item.title: Jazz in the Plaza — Sun Sep 20, 1:00 PM — Putnam Plaza
item.description:
Every Sunday: Free, live jazz every week performed by some of the best musicians in the SF Bay Area and beyond, right in the heart of downtown Petaluma! Every Sunday from 1 to 3:30, local jazz bassist and music book publisher Chuck Sher presents a rotating ensemble of professional, veteran jazz musicians in Putnam Plaza Park, right next to the Speakeasy. This event started in 2020 and has since become a staple for locals and visitors alike. Stop by and enjoy some of the best jazz the Bay Area has to offer!

item.title: Book Mark Story Awards Celebration — Thu Sep 24, 5:30 PM — Yountville Community Center
item.description:
The challenge is complete, and now it's time to jubilate! Join Yountville Arts for the Bookmark Story Celebration on Thursday, Sept. 24, from 5:30 to 7 p.m. in the Heritage Room of the Community Center, 6516 Washington Street.
Each writer was a resident, worker or student in Napa County. Writers submitted one or two unpublished stories in either prose or poetry format, with a limit of 60 words per story. A winning story connected all elements together, showing creativity and originality!
Submissions were accepted in English from adults or youth age 18 or younger, or in Spanish from youth age 18 or younger.
Yountville Arts, Napa County Libraries and Friends of the Yountville Library sponsor this event. Guests will join the people who support the contest and who will talk about why this technique of writing can be useful.
